basicInfo.recipeName: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Pasta

about.value: About This Recipe

This creamy garlic Parmesan chicken pasta is a comforting Italian-inspired dish made with tender chicken, fettuccine, and a rich, velvety sauce. Perfect for busy weeknights yet fancy enough for special dinners.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=afM7gVxT-Q8

faqs.ques: Can I use another type of pasta?
faqs.ans: Yes! Fettuccine is traditional, but penne, spaghetti, or linguine also work great.
You can substitute coconut cream and nutritional yeast instead of heavy cream and Parmesan.

step.value: Cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Add sliced chicken, season with salt and pepper, and cook until golden.
Add minced garlic and butter. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in heavy cream and Parmesan cheese. Stir until sauce thickens.
Toss the pasta in the sauce, garnish with parsley, and serve warm.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons olive oil
2 boneless chicken breasts, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup heavy cream
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1 tablespoon butter
8 oz fettuccine pasta (cooked al dente)
Salt and black pepper to taste
Fresh parsley for garnish
